remoterenderer.menu.title: RemoteRenderer settings
remoterenderer.menu.enabled.tip: Off: every item display is drawn by the vanilla renderer.
remoterenderer.menu.objmc.tip: Decode objmc texture meshes and draw them (invisible on vanilla 26.3).
remoterenderer.menu.cacheResolve.tip: A display whose item did not change is not resolved again.
remoterenderer.menu.cullOffscreen.tip: Display models and rigs outside the view are not drawn. Vanilla draws display entities even behind the camera.
remoterenderer.menu.ignoreCustomItemShad: Draw on the GPU even while a resource pack replaces the item shader (its effects on displays are lost).
remoterenderer.menu.hideWhileBakingQuads: New models with at least this many faces are not drawn for the moment their first bake takes.
remoterenderer.menu.bakeThreads.tip: Background threads baking new models. Takes effect after a restart.
remoterenderer.menu.rigs.tip: Rigs of the resource packs (remoterenderer/rigs) draw one skinned mesh instead of their bone displays.
remoterenderer.menu.rigPhysics.tip: Spring joints declared by rigs swing. Computed on each client only.
remoterenderer.menu.rigTextureMaxSize.ti: Bigger rig textures are scaled down when loaded. Two 4096 textures = 171 MB, 2048 = 43 MB.
remoterenderer.menu.rigTextureIdleSecond: Rig textures unused this long leave the GPU (loaded again when seen).
remoterenderer.menu.statsLogSeconds.tip: Write an RR_STATS line to the log this often.
remoterenderer.menu.clear.tip: Throw the baked models away and bake again.
remoterenderer.menu.reload.tip: Same as F3+T. Use it after editing rig files.
remoterenderer.menu.state.customShader: a resource pack replaces the item shader: %s
remoterenderer.menu.rigStats: %s rigs · %s drawn · %s off screen · rig textures %s MB
remoterenderer.menu.adaptCustomItemShade: When a resource pack replaces the item shader, run that shader instanced (its materials / HUD effects stay). Off: step aside for such packs.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.remoterendere: Draws item-display models (BetterModel, objmc) on the GPU, with rigs, physics and server shaders.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.remoteren: Item-display models (BetterModel bones and meshes, objmc) are baked once and drawn with GPU instancing. Resource-pack rigs add skinned joints, real textures, hair / skirt / cape physics and client animation clips; a server pack's own item shader keeps working (run instanced). Client side only.
remoterenderer.cmd.play.own: RemoteRenderer: rigs play their own clips again
remoterenderer.cmd.play: RemoteRenderer: every rig with clip %s plays it (preview)
remoterenderer.cmd.rigs.off: RemoteRenderer: rigs off (bone displays drawn as they are)
remoterenderer.menu.shaderCompat.tip: With an Iris shader pack on, models and rigs go through the pack's own programs (its lighting and shadows) instead of the vanilla renderer. Still no model resolving; rigs are skinned on the CPU.
remoterenderer.menu.state.shaderCompat: with the shader pack (its programs and shadows)
